name: Campus AI Track
description: Awarded for completing and passing the Campus AI Track: transformer architecture, backpropagation, convolutional networks, diffusion models, training dynamics and optimisation, decoding and hallucination, and evaluation methodology.

criteria.narrative: Complete all 8 lessons and their interactive labs — including a live gradient descent trainer, a token probability explorer and a written evaluation critique — then pass a 20-question assessment at 70% or above. The assessment is taken online and is not proctored.
